name: srusti-college-portal
description: Srusti Academy of Management and Technology — College Portal

scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && npm run build --workspace=apps/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/client
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npx playwright test
